cases.sql:
WITH locally_funded_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        f."cdscode",
        f."School Name",
        s.doctype,
        f."Enrollment (K-12)",
        f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
        (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS diff
    FROM public.frpm f
    JOIN public.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
      AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
)
, avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(diff) AS avg_diff_val FROM locally_funded_schools
)
SELECT 
    lfs."School Name", 
    lfs.doctype
FROM locally_funded_schools lfs
CROSS JOIN avg_diff
WHERE lfs.diff > avg_diff.avg_diff_val

WITH loans_96_97 AS (
  SELECT
    l.amount,
    SUBSTRING(l.date, 1, 2)::int AS year,
    c.gender
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.gender = 'M' AND (SUBSTRING(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' OR SUBSTRING(l.date, 1, 2) = '97')
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN sum_1996 = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND((sum_1997 - sum_1996) * 100.0 / sum_1996, 2)
  END AS growth_rate_percent
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 96 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_1996,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 97 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_1997
  FROM loans_96_97
) t

WITH bond_elements AS (
  SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    LEAST(a1.element, a2.element) AS element1,
    GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element) AS element2
  FROM public.bond b
  JOIN public.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN public.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN public.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
most_common AS (
  SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond_elements
  GROUP BY element1, element2
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
total_bonds AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM public.bond
),
most_common_count AS (
  SELECT cnt FROM most_common
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * most_common_count.cnt / total_bonds.total, 2) AS percentage
FROM most_common_count, total_bonds
